headline:
خريطة GTA 6 تقارب
حجم 3 ألعاب مجتمعة
label: حوار
note: Edge magazine cover feature (Edge 430, November 2026 issue), first published by GamesRadar+ 29 Oct 00:01Z (https://www.gamesradar.com/edge/gtavi-cover/), then PC Gamer 00:17-00:52Z. Edge: 'The map is roughly twice the size of GTAV's; Rockstar says its total landmass, including Vice City and the surrounding areas, is nearly as large as the playable maps of GTAIV, GTAV and RDR2 combined.' Edge: the studio art-directed 'around 600,000 animations'. Aaron Garbut, Rockstar North co-studio head (PC Gamer): 'I feel like we've built a pyramid on Everest.' Release 19 Nov 2026 (trailer end slate). Footage: Rockstar's launch trailer via IGN (2560x1440, 4.9 Mbps, decode clean). Sound: the trailer's music from 13.9 s ('Lucia Caminos' ends about 13.3 s) as one stretch: music to 30.0 s, then the trailer's song with its sung lyrics ('Like a flower in a hurricane...'), which is music, not dialogue (speech_ok); no spoken dialogue under any line. Shots: no guns, no intimate scenes; Rockstar Games presents title (15-17.9 s) avoided. Source flagged lowbit (4.6 Mbps against a 5.0 floor at 1440p); IGN's 3840 copy is the alternative if the strip shows blocks. v2: v1 stopped on the output smear check at 5.80-6.17 and 6.97-7.30 s, both inside the beach-and-biplane shot (55.2 s; red smoke on the 4.6 Mbps copy); replaced by the Keys highway (2.2 s). Line 2 now reads «حركة رسومية» (DeepL read «حركة» alone as 'trips'). v3: the closing shot (14.0 s) ran into Rockstar's 'ROCKSTAR GAMES PRESENTS' title card and the quote shot (63.2 s) showed a figure aiming a pistol; replaced by the rooftop at sunset (62.3 s) and the skyscraper glass shot (67.9 s).
speech_ok: director: sung lyrics of the trailer's song from 30.0 s (music, not dialogue); no spoken line under the story lines
